lessons.title: Mean, median, mode and range
lessons.task: These are the marks of 10 students in a quiz: $4,\ 8,\ 6,\ 5,\ 8,\ 3,\ 9,\ 8,\ 2,\ 7$. Find the **mean**, **median**, **mode** and **range** with the calculator.

steps.why: Count every value, even the repeated ones: there are $10$ marks. You will check this number on the calculator later.

steps.do: Press [[MENU]] to open the main menu.
Highlight **STAT** with the arrow keys and press [[EXE]].
steps.hint: STAT is the second icon of the first row.

steps.ask: The mark $8$ appears three times. How many times do you type it?
options: Once: the calculator knows it repeats
steps.why: Every value goes in the list, so the calculator can count it. If you type $8$ only once, the mean and the mode come out wrong.

steps.do: Type the first five marks into List 1, pressing [[EXE]] after each one: `4` [[EXE]] `8` [[EXE]] `6` [[EXE]] `5` [[EXE]] `8` [[EXE]].
steps.hint: Each number appears at the bottom of the screen while you type it, and goes into the list when you press [[EXE]].

steps.ask: Look at **1Var Freq**. It says $1$. What does that mean?
options: Each value in the list counts once
The answer will be rounded to $1$ decimal place
steps.why: Freq $= 1$ means every number in List 1 counts once. That is right for a list of numbers. (In frequency tables we will change it.)

steps.do: The settings are right. Press [[EXIT]] to go back.

steps.ask: First check **n**. What should it be?
steps.why: $n$ is how many values the calculator used. It must match your count: $10$. If not, a value is missing or typed twice.
$\bar{x}$ (x-bar) is the mean. $\Sigma x$ is the total of all the marks: mean $= \dfrac{\Sigma x}{n} = \dfrac{60}{10} = 6$. You don't need $\sigma x$ or $sx$ in Year 9.

steps.do: Press [[▼]] to scroll down to the rest of the results.
steps.hint: On your calculator, keep pressing ▼ until you see minX, Med, maxX and Mod.

steps.why: Med is the median, the middle value when the marks are in order: $2, 3, 4, 5, \mathbf{6}, \mathbf{7}, 8, 8, 8, 9$. With $10$ values it is halfway between $6$ and $7$: $6.5$.
Mod is the mode: the value that appears most often. $8$ appears $3$ times. (The mode is the value, $8$, not how many times it appears.)

steps.ask: The calculator doesn't show the range. How do you find it?
steps.why: Range $=$ largest $-$ smallest. The calculator gives both: maxX and minX.

lessons.result: Mean $= 6$, median $= 6.5$, mode $= 8$, range $= 7$. Always check $n$ first.
